channel.title: Paksh: Politics
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Minister Addresses Concerns Over Perceived Two-Tier Policing
item.description: Minister Chris Philp has outlined plans to address what he described as a 'corrosive' perception of two-tier policing. The initiative aims to tackle this issue within the police force. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.
